results.title: Vietnam, Love Is the Final Destination
results.original_title: Vietnam, l'amour est au bout du voyage
results.overview: This documentary is narrated in the first person by Mei‑Chen Chalais, who recounts her own life story — a childhood marked by the Vietnam War, her mother’s courage, and their journey from Hanoi to Saigon, and eventually to France.

results.title: Two Black Boys in Paradise
results.overview: Edan (19) and Dula (18) navigate love, identity, and self-acceptance on a journey about coming into oneself and out to the world. Confronting fear, shame, and societal expectations, the boys rediscover a sense of belonging in their own paradise, in this celebration of queer love, vulnerability, and the power of embracing who you are.

results.title: Boys About Town #1
results.overview: Two music-obsessed misfits fumble through crushes, bad decisions, and restless nights in the city of Petropolis. Bobby’s shy, Calvin’s reckless—and growing up might ruin the one thing they’ve got: each other. The first chapter in a four-part, real-time journey through youth, lust, and loyalty.

results.title: Power Child
results.overview: A young man runs away from home after accidentally killing his abusive father. Cal meets Travis. An imaginary friend who guides him through an unforeseen path to insanity.

results.title: Ruthless Bastards
results.overview: Two former gangster enforcers, filled with hate for one another, partner to take on one last assignment that could cost their lives.

results.title: Silence
results.overview: A high school senior and her mother navigate cultural barriers during their nightly routine of watching TV. As college dreams clash with familial expectations, unspoken tensions rise, and music becomes the language of their hidden desires and unexpressed love.

results.title: The Choice
results.overview: A young street artist struggles to find his way when a fellow artist reaches out to help him.

results.title: National Theatre Live: Death of England: Delroy
results.original_title: National Theatre Live: Death of England: Delroy
results.overview: Unapologetically upwardly mobile and working as a bailiff, Delroy’s life spirals out of control on one surreal day as he races to get to the hospital where his girlfriend Carly is about to give birth.

results.title: Tenía que ser de aquí: Luis Buñuel
results.original_title: Tenía que ser de aquí: Luis Buñuel

results.title: Sister
results.overview: In a post-apocalyptic Argentina dominated by an alien entity that kidnaps women, Helena searches for her sister and to find her she must join a group of strangers who are organizing a resistance.

results.title: Jacques the Giant Slayer
results.overview: In the early 20th century, an archaeologist discovers the skeleton of a human giant. A new and original version of the mythological fairy tale Jack and the Beanstalk.

results.title: South of the 38th Parallel
results.overview: Heading south from the 38th parallel, the Shipindao team turned their attention to South Korea. They spent over three hours telling a story of Korea and its history, one that differed from the legends.

results.title: Yo Yo
results.overview: In a desert at the southernmost point of Iran, a young man's mind is taken over by the  whispers in his head, while his friend tries to rescue him from a darkness only he can  hear.

results.title: Srikandi
results.overview: The story recounts the hardships Siti Zubaidah endured while tracking down her husband, Sultan Zainal Abidin—who had been abducted—a journey that forced her to give birth in the forest.  Siti Zubaidah later encountered pirates and discovered belongings that belonged to her husband. Meanwhile, the Sultanah ordered a commander to secretly search for the Sultan.  Siti Zubaidah emerged victorious in a battle against a band of land-based pirates, yet her husband remained unfound.

results.title: Rage
results.overview: Eric lives in a correctional facility. He tries to rebuild his relationship with his mother so he can live with her again when he turns 18. When she doesn’t show up to visit him, he runs away to go to her house. There, he discovers she has a new family and that she has moved on with her life.

results.title: The Fight
results.overview: A young Boy and his sister come face to face with the thing that he is fearing the most

results.title: National Theatre Live: The Importance of Being Earnest
results.original_title: National Theatre Live: The Importance of Being Earnest
results.overview: Being sensible can be excessively boring. At least Jack thinks so. While assuming the role of dutiful guardian in the country, he lets loose in town under a false identity. Meanwhile, his friend Algy takes on a similar facade. Unfortunately, living a double life has its drawbacks, especially when it comes to love. Hoping to impress two eligible ladies, the gentlemen find themselves caught in a web of lies they must carefully navigate.

results.title: Ed Sheeran: Amazon Music Songline
results.overview: Ed Sheeran breaks down the writing and recording process behind his new album Play and performs re-imagined classics alongside brand new songs in a special, intimate gig for Amazon Music Songline. Featuring in-depth interviews with key collaborators and songs never played live before, this is the full story of the latest chart-topping record from one of the most celebrated songwriters of our time.

results.title: Sammi, Who Can Detach His Body Parts
results.original_title: Sammi, Who Can Detach His Body Parts
results.overview: Sammi has the ability to remove parts of his body and give them to those he loves and wants to help. After his death, Sammi’s mother goes in search of the pieces of her son.
